folds.heading: ## Full UI-owner reconciliation, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Full reading preserves the owner’s mixed statuses: the general scene/report introduction does not erase the explicit proposed SUI13–SUI19 rows, and the proposed/in-use UR76–UR82/UIV defaults are not silently promoted by this application note (AD32). Existing user direction can already authorize an appropriate main-surface home under UR2/AD42; a new vote is not required merely because a receiving surface gains supported content. AD51 qualifies historical second-consumer phrasing where it governs shared software, without adopting a new report category or primitive.

The current prose-first clarification and UR35/53/57/60–74 retain the concrete task: known explanation and actual quote before commitment, real job review separate from Stop, focus/selection preserved through work and settlement, rendered sticky-header clearance at the current text size, and meaningful state feedback. A percentage needs a real supported measure. Illustration, whimsical expression and literary richness are dials, not required layers; narrator expression does not supply a character’s personality, knowledge or acts. Historical observation wording and ephemeral stream rows have different retention, and reloading is not a fresh report event.

Known unavailable actions need their actual admitted blocker; undiscovered content and engine-invalid fallback diagnostics follow their separate projection rules. SUI7’s continuing windows do not impose a universal safe pause, and RPT4 read-time names must preserve what was known then. Craft1 distinguishes browser-delivered activations rather than promising all physical key-repeat suppression. BF examples are authored applications, not proven prices, offices, starts, phased accounting or ordinary-life planners. Current desktop/text targets govern selected evidence; historical screen-use statistics and file/geometry/test counts are not renewed measurements here. No rule code, proposal status, runtime behavior or universal conformance matrix was added (AD36, AD43).

scope: Reviewer supplied content dispositions. Explicit read_mode distinguishes fresh reading from inspected prior full-content review reused on unchanged inputs. No hash-inferred semantics or renewed historical behavior proof.
